Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. Zimbabwe players stride out to the middle. Followed by the opening pair of Papua New Guinea of Lega Siaka and Assad Vala. It will be Richard Ngarava to start with the new ball.
The run chase...

Now the target is a huge one, PNG will need something special to chase this down as Zimbabwe have a really good bowling attack. For now, it seems it will Zimbabwe who will move into the finals but cricket is a game of uncertainties and we could well be in for a surprise.

PNG were not good with the ball and in the field! There were a few dropped chances and also, the bowling was a little too wayward. Most of their bowlers were taken to the cleaners. Bau though can be quite pleased with his figures and very easily he was the pick.

End of a brilliant batting performance from Zimbabwe and yet again they have got a score which we feel is well above par. Right from the word go, they batted with intent. The openers got them off to a flier. Then there was a good partnership for the third wicket which laid the foundation and the batters who came to bat after that, scored handy runs to put a big score on the board. It was a combined batting effort from Zimbabwe, there was no one stand out batter but everybody contributed.
Length ball, on off. Burl inside edges it to fine leg for a single. ZIMBABWE END THEIR INNINGS AT 199/5.
Short ball, around off. Burl pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Full length, on off. Shumba reverse sweeps it through point for one.
Burl punches this length ball through points for a single.
SIX! BOOM! Full length, on off. Ryan Burl smokes it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Length, outside off, Burl looks to chase it away but misses.
NO BALL! It is short and on off. Milton Shumba comes across and looks to hook it away. It goes to fine leg off the top edge. They take one. The umpire signals a no ball.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
OUT! TAKEN! Into the hands! This is tossed up on middle, it turns away. Williams goes for the slog sweep but it goes off the top edge and into the hands of the long on fielder.
Commentary.Howout: c Tony Ura b Charles Amini

Commentary.Commentary: Another two! Steps out but does not get to the pitch of it, still goes ahead with the shot, it lands safe in the mid on region. Two taken.
SIX! That is trademark Sean Williams! He makes room, this is tossed up around leg, eh brings the slog sweep out and clears the deep mid-wicket fence.
Short and around off, this is pulled down to long on for one.
SIX! Over the fence! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled flat and hard, the fielder at deep mid-wicket runs to his left, dives but it goes over him and also over the fence.
SIX! Clears the fence! Full and on middle, this is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a big one. 200 is still possible. 30 needed in 2.
Full and outside off, this is lofted over cover for one.
Hit hard again but only for one! A full toss on off, this is swept through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Helped on its way! Moves across, this is full and on middle, it is swept over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Just the one run off the Free Hit! Bowls it well wide outside off, Williams could have left it alone but goes after it, it goes off the toe-end and lands safe in the mid off region for one.
NO BALL TO BEGIN WITH! It is not a front foot no ball, it i has landed outside the strip. No ball signaled. Free Hit coming up.
Two more! Outstanding running! On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket for two.
On off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Runs flowing now! Down the leg side, Shumba sweeps it fine and it races away to the fence. It was a gift and Shumba puts it away.
Two! On middle, Shumba works it towards mid-wicket for two.

SIX! Just over the fencxe! That was the longer side and Shumba hit that really well! On middle, he whips it, it goes high up in the air, the fielder at deep square leg, moves back but it clears him, JUST!
Two more! On middle, this is worked towards wide long on for a couple.
A dot to end! Outside off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
The sweep is out now! It is hit hard through mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a really good catch and the dangerous Raza falls! He gets out to a full toss. Steps out, it is a knee height full toss, you would normally expect him to hit that out of the ground but swings way too hard, loses his shape and it goes more off the splice. It is also the longer part so the fielder at deep mid-wicket, Lega Siaka moves to his left and takes a tumbling catch. This could well make a difference of 15 runs to the final score.
Commentary.Howout: c Lega Siaka b Charles Amini

Commentary.Commentary: Short and this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, Raza works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Another run to end the over! An action-packed on! The last ball is pushed down to long on for one.
Two more! Fuller and on middle, this is whipped wide of the fielder at long on and two is taken.
FOUR! Deft! Shorter and outside off, Raza waits and plays it fine on the off side for another boundary.

OUT! TAKEN! Wesley Madhevere's good little innings comes to an end! A good outing for him on his comeback! He looks to go after the bowler. Moves across and tries to go for the slog sweep. This is on a length and around off, it goes off the top edge and it is a simple catch to the man at long on. Can PNG build on this now?
Commentary.Howout: c Norman Vanua b Riley Hekure

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Excellent innovation! The reverse sweep is out, it is hit nice and fine and to the third man fence for a boundary.
Does not find the gap! Fuller and on off, it is hit hard but to covers.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Gives it a lot of air and lands it full and on middle, it is hit down to long off for one.
Flatter and on middle, Raza defends it out.
Another one a little too short, Raza pulls it through square leg and takes two again.
A little too short, Raza looks to pull but it goes more off the inner half through mid-wicket for two.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, Wesley Madhevere hits it down to long off and takes one.
Just another one! Shorter and on middle, Raza goes for the heave, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one.
On off, Raza pushes it down to long off for one.
The slog sweep is out, it goes more off the inner half down towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Lovely running! Fuller and on middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket with soft hands, two taken.
Length ball, on off. Wesley Madhevere hits it down to long on for a single.
A single as this is worked to covers.
FOUR! Sikandar Raza has come out with an intent. It is tossed up, around leg. Sikandar Raza goes down on one knee and drags his sweep to fine leg for a boundary.
Looped up, on off. Raza punches it through covers for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sese Bau grabs his second wicket of the innings. It is short and on off. Craig Ervine pulls it to deep mid-wicket. He does not get the desired distance on it. Assad Vala takes a sharp catch in the deep. Sikandar Raza is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Assad Vala b Sese Bau

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on leg. Wesley Madhevere sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, on off. Craig Ervine punches it down the ground for a brace.
A single again as this short ball is worked to square leg.
Short ball, on off. Ervine pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full length, on the leg stumps. Craig Ervine moves across and sweeps it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Touch fuller, on middle and leg. Wesley Madhevere sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Full length, on middle and off. Craig Ervine defends it to covers for a single.

DROPPED! That should have been taken! Ervine makes room, this is tossed up on off, Ervine looks to go over covers but it goes off the outer half wide of the fielder at long off. He runs there and looks to take it with a slide but spills it.
Shortish and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two more.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Two more! On middle, this is worked wide of the fielder at deep mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, Ervine looks to pull but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and a run is taken.
On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! BANG! The last ball spoils the over! Ervine makes room, this is full and outside off. It is thumped down the ground and over the long off fence for a biggie.
Another single as this is nudged through mid-wicket.
Another one on a length and around off, Wesley Madhevere guides it to point.
Shorter in length and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
On the stumps, this is played back to the bowler.
On off, this is eased down to long off for one.
A single to end! Shorter and outside off, Wesley Madhevere guides it through point for one.
Now Ervine pushes this down to long off and takes one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one more.
FOUR! Short ball and the gap is found! On middle, Wesley Madhevere rocks back and hammers it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another single as this is clipped through the leg side.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Now takes one by pushing this down to long off.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! On the shorter side again, this is pulled again through square leg and it results in another boundary.
FOUR! Worked away! On the pads, Wesley Madhevere puts it away through square leg and this one races away to the fence.

DROPPED! That is a dolly! On off, length, it is hit on the up but straight to mid off. The fielder moves to his left but spills the catch. The height was a little awkward but should have been taken. A single in the end.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
A huge appeal but turned down! On the pads, Wesley Madhevere looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
FOUR! A boundary to end the Powerplay and it is a good one for the batting side! The last ball is yet again caressed through covers as it is bowled outside off.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
FOUR! Through the off side! Ervine now joins the act! Outside off, he makes room and slams it through covers. Boundary.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Put away! Off the mark in style! Shorter and outside off, Wesley Madhevere cuts it through point and bags a boundary.

OUT! A huge appeal and the finger is raised! LBW! PNG get the opening wicket they so desperately wanted! This is fired on middle, Regis Chakabva looks to move across and sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. A loud shout and the umpire raises the finger. Good wicket for PNG as Regis was looking dangerous.
9 from the over then! Still though, a good comeback by the bowler after going for a few in the first three balls. On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Shorter and outside off, Regis Chakabva cuts but to point.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
SIX! Over the fence! Tossed up on middle, Regis Chakabva steps out and lofts it well over the long off fence for a biggie.
Ervine steps out and looks to go over long on but does not connect that well, it falls well short of the fielder there and a run is taken.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Yet another dot! A maiden by Bau. Brilliant! On off, this is played to point.
Another dot! Shorter and around off, this is cut to point.
Ervine looks to innovate, tries to play the reverse sweep but misses.
Yet again darts it on middle, kept out.
Pushes this one through and bowls it on middle, Ervine plays it back to the bowler.
Well bowled! Sees the batter come down the track and drags the length back. Ervine defends it.
Well played! On a good length and on off, defended.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side, a slower one. Wided.
FOUR! Slammed away! Three in a row for Regis Chakabva! Shorter and on off, this is thumped past the mid off fielder and into the boundary again.
FOUR! Thumped down the ground! Regis Chakabva is dealing in boundaries! Length and on middle, this is thumped down the ground and to the long on fence.
FOUR! Hammered! Shorter and outside off, Chakabva stands tall and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Well bowled! Length and angling away from off. Regis looks to drive but is beaten.
On middle, this is worked on the leg side for one. An expensive first by the spinner.
Shorter and outside off, Regis looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Up and over! Second boundary in the over. He makes room, this is bowled full and on off, Regis lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
A single to follow now as this is pushed down to long on.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Lovely touch from Ervine! This is pushed through. Ervine just uses the pace of the bowler and plays the paddle scoop, fine on the leg side for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, Ervine works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! The last ball spoils the over! Regis comes down the track, makes it into a half volley and thumps it down the ground to the long on fence. First of the game.
Yet another dot! A good first over so far! On a length and around off, this is pushed to covers.
Regis threw the kitchen sink at that one! Shorter and outside off, Regis Chakabva goes hard after it but is beaten.
On the pads, Ervine is off the mark as he works it down to fine leg and takes one.
BEATEN! Good length and outside off, Ervine slashes at it but is beaten.
Zimbabwe are underway! On the pads, Regis works it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick run. Good single that.
It is time for the action to begin! The players make their way out to the middle. Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine are the openers for Zimbabwe. Semo Kamea to open the bowling. Here we go...
TOSS - ZIMBABWE HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO BAT!

It is time for the Semi Finals! One more win for either of these teams and they'll ensure their place in the upcoming T20I World Cup. It is Zimbabwe taking on PNG. The former have been the best side so far in this tournament and are heavy favorites to win this game. PNG though are quite unpredictable and on their day are surely good enough to beat a side better than them. Can they do it in this all-important game though?
